notes: SEQN is the unique respondent identifier; maps to person_source_value to link all records to the same individual.
Dietary day one sample weight is a continuous numeric value; stored in observation.value_as_number with appropriate observation_concept_id for survey weight.
Dietary two-day sample weight is a continuous numeric value; stored in observation.value_as_number with appropriate observation_concept_id for survey weight.
Dietary recall status is categorical; maps to value_as_concept_id using a custom concept for recall status.
Interviewer ID code is an identifier; stored as string in observation.value_as_string with observation_concept_id for interviewer.
Breast-fed infant binary indicator; maps to value_as_concept_id using standard Yes/No concepts (e.g., 4188539 Yes, 4188540 No).
Number of days of intake is categorical; maps to value_as_concept_id with custom concepts for number of days.
Intake day of the week is categorical; maps to value_as_concept_id using standard day-of-week concepts if available.
Language used mostly is categorical; maps to value_as_concept_id using language concepts (e.g., OMOP Ethnicity or custom).
Main respondent indicator is categorical; maps to value_as_concept_id with custom concepts for respondent type.
Helped in responding indicator is categorical; maps to value_as_concept_id with custom concepts for assistance.
Type of table salt used is categorical; maps to value_as_concept_id using salt type concepts (e.g., standard or custom).
Frequency of adding salt at table is categorical; maps to value_as_concept_id using frequency concepts.
Salt used in preparation is categorical; maps to value_as_concept_id using Yes/No concepts.
On special diet binary indicator; maps to value_as_concept_id using standard Yes/No concepts.
